detail.longDescription: Plaud records the conversation, whether it happened on Zoom or over coffee. What it can't do is decide where the notes go next. So transcripts pile up in the Plaud app, and the follow-ups everyone agreed to depend on someone remembering to copy them out. Now you can set up that handoff from the AI tool you already use. Add Zapier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor, describe what should happen once a recording is processed, and your agent builds it. Zapier takes over from there and keeps going after t
